summary: Frontend-only regression for Storefront Merge + Wallet Sharing Nudge on the LIVE-prod-DB preview (read-only + route interception, no writes). Verified sidebar consolidation, /storefront tab shell (click + deep-link + browser Back), Share tab (link '/hostbay' + copy/open/x/whatsapp/telegram/email + QR), Products tab list & buttons, legacy /creator and /pay-links/products server redirects, public /hostbay creator-shop-section (server-rendered + product click → /hostbay/p/test-ebook-setup-guide + mobile 390px + /hostbay/shop still 200), wallet reuse nudge via route interception (GET wallet/getWallet + wallet/reusable-wallets + POST wallet/copyWalletAddresses fulfilled → nudge appears with correct copy, Copy 3 wallets fires the intercepted POST, success toast shown, nudge disappears), normal /wallet does NOT show the nudge and scope chip reads 'hostbay · Business', and dashboard/pay-links/transactions regressions still pass. Two functional gaps found in the product editor back-buttons (missing data-testid on /pay-links/products/1/edit and /pay-links/products/new), plus a dev-mode React warning on public /hostbay.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid=products-edit-back is NOT present on the edit page after clicking product-row-edit-1. The spec requires this back button to return to /storefront?tab=products. Page loads at /pay-links/products/1/edit but the back-link testid is missing (0 matches).

data-testid=products-new-back is NOT present on the new-product page after clicking products-new-btn. The spec requires this back button to return to /storefront?tab=products. Page loads at /pay-links/products/new but the back-link testid is missing (0 matches).

React dev warning repeated on load: 'Invalid prop `children` supplied to `ForwardRef(Box)`, expected a ReactNode' originating from Components/Page/Creator/CreatorProfile.tsx:72. Non-blocking in prod but pollutes the console and indicates an accidental non-node child (likely a boolean / undefined from a short-circuit).
Two GET 404s recorded during public page load (resources not identified by URL — likely a missing avatar or shop-image thumbnail). Cosmetic but shows as broken image / console noise.

action_items: Add data-testid="products-edit-back" to the back button on /pay-links/products/[id]/edit and wire it to router.push('/storefront?tab=products').
Add data-testid="products-new-back" to the back button on /pay-links/products/new and wire it to router.push('/storefront?tab=products').

Fix the CreatorProfile Box invalid-children warning (Components/Page/Creator/CreatorProfile.tsx:72) — likely a stray `&&` returning false/undefined; convert to a null-returning ternary or wrap the conditional in a Fragment.
Investigate the two 404s on public /hostbay (open DevTools → Network on that page and identify the failing asset — probably an avatar or product thumbnail with a missing/renamed path).
critical_code_review_comments: The Storefront tab shell correctly serves ?tab= as the URL source of truth and browser Back works, but the redirect targets /pay-links/products/{id}/edit and /pay-links/products/new lost their testid'd back button during the merge — the merge is incomplete for those two child routes.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only session. All wallet endpoints (getWallet, reusable-wallets, copyWalletAddresses) were intercepted with page.route so no real writes were made to the LIVE production DB.
test_credentials: hostbay@moxx.co / Katiekendra123@ (2-step login: email → Enter → password → [data-testid=signin-submit-btn])
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Verified this round: (1) Sidebar: only 'Storefront' item visible, no 'Creator page' or 'Products' link. (2) /storefront: h1='Storefront', header 'View my page' (storefront-open-page) present. (3) Tabs: clicking storefront-tab-products/-share/-page updates the URL to ?tab=products / ?tab=share / (no tab), and the corresponding data-testids products-list / storefront-share / creator-page render — no full reload. (4) Deep links /storefront?tab=products and /storefront?tab=share render the correct tab on a fresh SSR load; browser Back from share returns to products. (5) Share tab: storefront-share-url text is exactly '/hostbay' (scheme-less is intentional per NEXT_PUBLIC_CREATOR_BASE_URL='') and storefront-share-copy/-open/-x/-whatsapp/-telegram/-email are all present + QR renders. (6) Products tab: products-list, product-row-1 ('Test Ebook Setup Guide'), products-new-btn, products-view-shop-btn all present. (7) Legacy redirects: /creator → /storefront?tab=page (200), /pay-links/products → /storefront?tab=products (200), no 404/flash. (8) Public /hostbay: creator-shop-section titled 'Shop · 1 item' with creator-shop-product-1 ('Test Ebook Setup Guide' + '$5.00' + 'Buy →'), server-rendered (all three markers present in raw HTML), clicking the card lands on /hostbay/p/test-ebook-setup-guide, /hostbay/shop still returns 200. (9) Mobile 390px: /hostbay and /storefront both render without horizontal overflow, all three storefront tabs visible on mobile. (10) Wallet nudge (intercepted): with getWallet fulfilled empty + reusable-wallets fulfilled with the Hostbay Studios fake payload, wallet-reuse-nudge renders with copy 'Use the same wallets as Hostbay Studios … 3 addresses (BTC, ETH, USDT-TRC20) …', wallet-reuse-nudge-copy label reads 'Copy 3 wallets', wallet-reuse-nudge-add-new present. Clicking Copy triggers the intercepted POST /api/wallet/copyWalletAddresses exactly once, success toast containing 'copied' appears, and the nudge disappears. Normal /wallet has no nudge and wallet-account-scope='hostbay · Business'. (11) Add wallet modal: opens, but wallet-reuse-selector is legitimately not rendered for a single-account merchant — per spec this is expected; GET /api/wallet/reusable-wallets from the page background request returned OK (the standalone fetch inside page.evaluate returned 401, harmless — cookies not forwarded). (12) Regressions: dashboard 'Payments today' + '… yesterday' delta present, pay-links search + no-results + Clear filters OK, /transactions 200, account-setup-warning present on dashboard header. 

What still needs main-agent attention: the two missing back-button testids on the product edit/new pages, the CreatorProfile Box children warning, and the two 404s on /hostbay.
rca_of_the_issue: products-edit-back / products-new-back: the pages /pay-links/products/[id]/edit and /pay-links/products/new were left in place as the actual editor routes but the back button was probably wired to router.back() without a data-testid. The Storefront merge added the two testids to the SPEC but not to the actual editor component headers. Fix is a one-line data-testid addition on the existing back arrow/link in each editor page (and confirm the click routes to /storefront?tab=products, not router.back(), so the user always lands on the merged Products tab).
